storage_check.title: Check the database file
storage_check.description: Check that the SQLite file holds no component row without its parent record (entity) and no reference to a nonexistent entity. These can be missed by ordinary entity queries, so this asks the connection directly: whether foreign keys are enforced, which rows violate one, and what SQLite’s own integrity_check reports. Takes no arguments. Returns a report in content.body, with warning or failure findings when present; it does not repair the records or configuration.

archetype_check.title: Check entity component sets
archetype_check.description: Check that each entity’s archetype pointer matches the components it actually has. An entity is a stored record; its components are named groups of fields, and its archetype pointer identifies the set of component types present. Direct database writes that bypass the graph can leave these pointers stale, causing reads and query planning to use the wrong component set. Takes no arguments. Returns a report in content.body, with warning or failure findings when present; it does not repair the records or configuration.
